record.excerpt: This Bitcoin trading strategy made 494.47% in the last 2 years … I have backtested this strategy since January 2021 over a sample size of almost 300 trades … The strategy is based on the 1H EMA and only works on the Bybit BTC/USDT chart. … add the ATR indicator to the chart (make sure the value of ATR is 14). … Every time the price moves above the 20 EMA on the 1H chart of BTC/USDT on Bybit … If the next candle closed above the previous candle's high, you long. … SL will be at the current price - (2 * ATR indicator) … TP will be at the current price + 1.8 * (current price - SL price ).
record.notes: Fully mechanical 1h EMA20 cross + breakout confirm, 2xATR14 stop, 1.8R target; big return claim with 3% risk sizing; author says Bybit-only (we test Binance).
